persona.name: dumper
persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Make a square watercolour illustration of a little stone cottage beside a stream, with soft green hills behind it. No text.
bank.Style: Watercolour, with soft washes and visible paper texture.
bank.Scene: A little stone cottage beside a stream, with soft green hills behind it.

messages.text: I'd like you to make a watercolour illustration of a little stone cottage beside a stream. I've been picturing a place like this as a little mental escape when things feel busy. The image should be square, and there should be soft green hills behind the cottage. I think that's why I keep coming back to this particular scene. Please don't include any text.
